newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mazda Feb domestic output falls 3.3% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Mazda Feb domestic output falls 3.3% yr/yr.

text.p: Mazda Motor Corp said on Friday its domestic vehicle production, exports, domestic sales and overseas output in February were as follows (with percentage change from a year earlier):

Mazda's domestic vehicle production fell in February for the first time in two months on a year-on-year basis, due to lower output of the 660cc minicar Carol before the model was partially remodelled on March 4, a Mazda spokesman said.
Domestic sales rose for the second successive month on a year-on-year basis due to higher demand for the new Demio compact wagon ahead of a consumption tax hike on April 1, he said.
Exports rose for the fifth successive month on a year-on-year basis, reflecting higher shipments to Oceania, the Middle East and Africa, the spokesman said.
